acceptance: A release-canary run on a develop head with both fixes is green
Issue #2728 is closed by the workflow, or each remaining failure has its own tracker item
context: Dispatching a workflow is outward-facing; do it only with the owner's go-ahead. The 2026-10-05 scheduled canary was green, so the failures are recent regressions.
description: Dispatch release-canary.yml on a develop head that contains both the compat-gate test fix and the chdb leak fix. The failing set has changed daily (4, 9 and 3 failing tests on 2026-10-06, 07 and 08), so treat any new failure as a new defect with its own item rather than extending this one. The canary incident issue closes on the next green run, which unblocks release PRs.
